title: Practice 3: Rain falls, time flies, luck comes: the idioms

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: А, ___ (идти — to go, walk, one way; impf., pres. 3rd sg.) снег!.
exercises.why: **идет** — present tense (3rd person singular) of идти: one-direction verb (many directions: ходить).

exercises.q: Время ___ (лететь — to fly, one way; impf., past n. sg.) быстро.
exercises.why: **летело** — past tense (neuter) of лететь: one-direction verb (many directions: летать).

exercises.q: Время ___ (бежать — to run, one way; impf., pres. 3rd sg.) быстро.
exercises.why: **бежит** — future tense (3rd person singular) of бежать: one-direction verb (many directions: бегать).

exercises.q: Цветы ей не ___ (идти — to go, walk, one way; impf., pres. 3rd pl.).
exercises.why: **идут** — present tense (3rd person plural) of идти: one-direction verb (many directions: ходить).

exercises.q: А о чём речь ___ (идти — to go, walk, one way; impf., past f. sg.)?
exercises.why: **шла** — past tense (feminine) of идти: one-direction verb (many directions: ходить).

exercises.q: Работа ___ (идти — to go, walk, one way; impf., past f. sg.) споро.
exercises.why: **шла** — past tense (feminine) of идти: one-direction verb (many directions: ходить).

exercises.q: Часы ___ (идти — to go, walk, one way; impf., pres. 3rd pl.) медленно.
exercises.why: **идут** — present tense (3rd person plural) of идти: one-direction verb (many directions: ходить).

exercises.q: Как быстро время ___ (лететь — to fly, one way; impf., pres. 3rd sg.)!
exercises.why: **летит** — present tense (3rd person singular) of лететь: one-direction verb (many directions: летать).

exercises.q: Он туда скорей ___ (идти — to go, walk, one way; impf., pres. 3rd sg.).
exercises.why: **идёт** — present tense (3rd person singular) of идти: one-direction verb (many directions: ходить).

exercises.q: Совеем не ___ (повезти — to take off (by vehicle); pf., past n. sg.)!
exercises.why: **повезло** — past tense (neuter) of повезти: the perfective of везти, «set out».

exercises.q: Ему очень ___ (повезти — to take off (by vehicle); pf., past n. sg.).
exercises.why: **повезло** — past tense (neuter) of повезти: the perfective of везти, «set out».

exercises.q: Ничего не ___ (лезть — to climb, one way; impf., past n. sg.) в голову!
exercises.why: **лезло** — past tense (neuter) of лезть: one-direction verb (many directions: лазить).

exercises.q: Мне не ___ (везти — to convey by vehicle, one way; impf., past n. sg.).
exercises.why: **везло** — past tense (neuter) of везти: one-direction verb (many directions: возить).

exercises.q: Мне не ___ (везти — to convey by vehicle, one way; impf., pres. 3rd sg.).
exercises.why: **везёт** — present tense (3rd person singular) of везти: one-direction verb (many directions: возить).

exercises.q: На дворе густо ___ (идти — to go, walk, one way; impf., pres. 3rd sg.) снег.
exercises.why: **идёт** — present tense (3rd person singular) of идти: one-direction verb (many directions: ходить).

exercises.q: Одному мне ___ (везти — to convey by vehicle, one way; impf., pres. 3rd sg.)!
exercises.why: **везёт** — present tense (3rd person singular) of везти: one-direction verb (many directions: возить).

exercises.q: Как бы ___ (вести — to lead, take along, one way; impf., past pl.) себя?
exercises.why: **вели** — past tense (plural) of вести: one-direction verb (many directions: водить).

exercises.q: Некоторое время ___ (идти — to go, walk, one way; impf., past pl.) молча.
exercises.why: **шли** — past tense (plural) of идти: one-direction verb (many directions: ходить).

exercises.q: Однако ему не ___ (везти — to convey by vehicle, one way; impf., past n. sg.).
exercises.why: **везло** — past tense (neuter) of везти: one-direction verb (many directions: возить).

exercises.q: Ведь канальское время ___ (бежать — to run, one way; impf., pres. 3rd sg.), не ждет!
exercises.why: **бежит** — future tense (3rd person singular) of бежать: one-direction verb (many directions: бегать).
